speaker: narrator
text: What if a *gambler* suddenly owned the casino?

speaker: narrator
text: Jay has lost *everything* in this casino. Twice.

speaker: narrator
text: Then the old owner hands him *the keys*.

speaker: owner
text: It's yours, kid. Every table. Every *machine*.

speaker: hero
text: Wait. Why would you give it *away*?

speaker: owner
text: So *you* can find out how it works.

speaker: narrator
text: Day one. The new boss has *one plan*.

speaker: hero
text: Everybody *wins* tonight!

speaker: narrator
text: He sets every machine to *pay out*.

speaker: narrator
text: Jackpot. Jackpot. *Jackpot.*

speaker: bit
text: Jay. We just lost *four million dollars*.

speaker: hero
text: Relax. People *love* me now!

speaker: narrator
text: By midnight, the vault is *empty*.

speaker: bit
text: Payroll is tomorrow. We have *eleven dollars*.

speaker: hero
text: Can we borrow money from the *casino*?

speaker: bit
text: Jay. *You* are the casino.

speaker: narrator
text: Then the phone rings. The old owner is *laughing*.

speaker: narrator
text: Part two. The gambler boss is *broke*.

speaker: owner
text: Lesson one, kid. The house doesn't *cheat*.

speaker: hero
text: Then how does it *always* win?

speaker: bit
text: Simple math. Let me *show* you.

speaker: narrator
text: A roulette wheel has *thirty seven* pockets.

speaker: narrator
text: Hit one number, they pay *thirty five to one*.

speaker: bit
text: A fair price is *thirty six*. That missing chip?

speaker: bit
text: That's *ours*.

speaker: narrator
text: That's a house edge of about *two point seven percent*.

speaker: bit
text: Tiny edge. Millions of spins. *Guaranteed* profit.

speaker: hero
text: So every time I played here...

speaker: bit
text: You were paying for the *chandelier*.

speaker: narrator
text: Jay reopens with normal odds. Money *flows in*.

speaker: hero
text: Bit, I'm *rich*! I'm actually rich!

speaker: narrator
text: Then a man in a purple beanie walks in.

speaker: narrator
text: He looks *exactly* like old Jay.

speaker: gambler
text: I've got a system. I *can't* lose.

speaker: narrator
text: And he bets *his house*.

speaker: narrator
text: Part three. A stranger just bet *his house*.

speaker: hero
text: Sir, please. Don't do *this*.

speaker: gambler
text: You're the boss. You *want* me to lose.

speaker: bit
text: Technically... *he's right*.

speaker: narrator
text: The wheel spins. The whole floor *goes quiet*.

speaker: dealer
text: Seventeen. *Black*.

speaker: narrator
text: He bet on red. He *loses*.

speaker: narrator
text: Jay looks at the money. Then at *the man*.

speaker: hero
text: Bit. Give him his house *back*.

speaker: bit
text: That breaks the *entire* business model.

speaker: hero
text: Then break it. *Do it.*

speaker: gambler
text: Why would a *casino* do that?

speaker: hero
text: Because I used to be *you*.

speaker: narrator
text: That night, Jay hangs one sign by the door.

speaker: narrator
text: Business drops *forty percent*.

speaker: bit
text: Jay. Mr. Vance wants his keys *back*.

speaker: narrator
text: Turns out... he *never* really sold it.

speaker: owner
text: Lesson two, kid. Always read the *contract*.

speaker: narrator
text: Follow for season two.
